answers.label: Feedback on refined scope 2 definition
answers.text: We would need to see the proposed text for a refined definition in order to comment. In general we support concise definitions that don't try to include too many aspects that are also addressed elsewhere. For instance, if attributional GHG inventories are made up of scope 1-3 emissions, it may not be necessary to include this information in the definition (since it's covered in the definition of an attributional GHG invnetory).
